historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case FY2028 organic growth (year 3). The historical CAGRs are not a forward proxy: they span a year-end change (31 Mar to 31 Dec; FY2025 is 3.75 years after FY2022 and 5.75 after FY2020), the Linkz common-control merger (FY2020 restated 2,780m used for the 5-year base, not the 1,439m as originally reported) and the DJC acquisition, and the AI server/data-centre surge of FY2024-26.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (30%) sits ~30% below revenue CAGR (39%) and ~38% below EPS CAGR (48%): growth has been funded with debt (related-party loans), acquisition shares and the FY2026 placing rather than retained earnings alone. Owner-FCF CAGRs are near-meaningless on this series: FY2023 owner FCF was -1,675m and FY2024 +805m on working-capital swings.
historical_growth.notes: SBC-adjusted FCF CAGR (35.6% 3yr) vs reported (36.4%): SBC is ~0.3% of revenue, immaterial to the growth read. The divergence that matters is OCF vs profit -- cumulative FY2023 to H1 FY2026 owner FCF is roughly -HK$2.5bn against cumulative net income of ~HK$2.3bn; the business has not yet converted its AI-cycle earnings into cash.

scenario_narratives.base: AI data-centre demand stays strong through FY2027 but decelerates thereafter: FY2026 organic revenue ~HK$21bn (H2 at H1's level), +18% in FY2027 as Vietnam/Mexico/Turkey capacity and Morocco ramp, then single digits. Operating EBITDA margin holds ~9%: the high-margin fibre assembly business (MPO, double-density panels, shuffle boxes at 20%+ segment margin) grows fast enough to offset the structurally thin server-assembly (2.7%) and copper-wire (2.5%, copper pass-through) mix. Working capital consumes 15% of every incremental revenue dollar, so year-1 owner FCF is roughly zero despite ~HK$1.3bn of NOPAT, and cash conversion only arrives once growth slows. Leoni LCS is carried at its buyout-implied value, contributing nothing to the flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: The hyperscaler capex cycle extends: 800V DC liquid-cooled power cables and scale-up fibre connectivity add a second product wave, Leoni's European/American plants open global CSP customers, and the data-centre fibre mix lifts group EBITDA margin to 11%. Growth +28%/+18%/+12% in FY2027-29. Working-capital intensity eases to 12% of incremental revenue as the server business matures and payables terms with the Luxshare supply chain lengthen. Terminal growth 3%.
scenario_narratives.bear: AI capex digests in FY2027 (flat) and contracts in FY2028 (-10%) as hyperscalers pause; server assembly, which is 43-60% of revenue, is the most exposed and least differentiated line, and Luxshare -- parent, lender and supply-chain counterparty -- can in-source it. Copper-wire margins stay at 2-3% and group operating EBITDA margin falls to 6.5% before a partial recovery to 7%. Working capital at -20% of incremental revenue traps cash in the up-years (released in the down-year). The HK$4.5bn placing proves to have funded inventory and receivables rather than returns. Terminal growth 2%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A contract manufacturer with one genuinely differentiated franchise (Tier-1 MPO/fibre assemblies for AI data centres, 20%+ segment margin) wrapped in two commodity-like ones (server assembly, copper wire) that generate most of the revenue and almost none of the profit. Value it on unlevered owner FCF with working capital charged on growth, because that is where the cash has gone: HK$4.5bn of equity raised in H1 FY2026 and HK$3.1bn of parent loans are financing inventory and receivables. The share count and net cash are taken at 30 Jun 2026 so the dilution is fully in the per-share figures. Leoni LCS, consolidated from Aug 2026, is excluded from the flows and carried at its buyout-implied value because no filing here discloses its revenue or debt.
key_risks_to_valuation: Working-capital intensity: every 5pp on wc_capture is worth roughly HK$1/share; if NWC stays at the 29%-of-revenue level seen at 30 Jun 2026 rather than reverting toward 13%, the base case overstates value.
AI capex cycle: server and data-centre fibre were 54% of H1 FY2026 revenue; a hyperscaler pause is the bear case and is weighted 30%.

Controller dependency: Luxshare Precision controls the company, lent it HK$3.1bn at 30 Jun 2026, and sits in the same server supply chain; terms, in-sourcing and transfer pricing are outside minority control.

Leoni LCS Group: consolidated from 1 Aug 2026 with undisclosed revenue, margin and debt. Carried at HK$194m; the 49% associate stake earned HK$165m in H1 FY2026, so this is the largest upside omission -- and Leoni's debt the largest unquantified downside.
Copper price pass-through: copper wire (29% of H1 revenue) and networking cable revenues move with LME copper; the margin paths assume no inventory-holding losses.
Dilution: the count rose from 1,990m to 2,232m in 18 months via placings and acquisition shares; further general-mandate placings would cut per-share value directly.
Pre-FY2024 restatements (Linkz common-control merger; 2025 revaluation-model change) make the historical series only partly like-for-like.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 11.95-24.70
data_sources.financials: 1729.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, millions HKD) and the FY2025 annual report / H1 FY2026 interim report under Extracted/: segment note 6 (FY2025 AR), interim balance sheet and cash flow (30 Jun 2026), notes 12-14 (inventories, receivables, payables), note 21 (Time Singapore buyout), share option note, FY2025 AR note 42 (DJC acquisition)
data_sources.qualitative: H1 FY2026 interim MD&A (segment commentary, placing use of proceeds, Leoni LCS and DJC integration); 1729.HK_Analysis.json (bull/bear cases, risks, guidance; read after the first build -- it corroborates the scenario axes and the Luxshare-concentration bear weight, and moved no driver)

inputs.share_count_basis: 2,232.3m shares issued at 30 Jun 2026 (interim, after the Feb/May 2026 placings of 246.1m shares) plus ~78m treasury-method dilution from the 91.1m options outstanding (H1 FY2026 diluted-EPS note: 2,173.1m diluted vs ~2,095m basic weighted). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. The DJC consideration shares (21.7m, Dec 2025) and the placings are already in the 2,232.3m.
inputs.debt_composition: Bank borrowings HK$965.9m + loans from related companies (Luxshare group) HK$3,076.8m at 30 Jun 2026; lease liabilities HK$183.9m EXCLUDED (treatment B, lease cash charged in flows). Pledged bank deposits HK$301.0m are restricted and sit in equity_bridge, not in cash.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, equity-settled share-based payments HK$44,405k (line 6364 FY2024 AR shows prior-year 41,450k); no cash taxes on equity awards disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 in kpis). Options settled by subscription, not net-share.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in HKD. HKD is pegged to USD so the HK 10y (~3.9%) tracks the UST; ERP 6.0% plus ~1pp for a Luxshare-controlled mid-cap PRC/Vietnam manufacturer with >50% revenue tied to one capex cycle gives a cost of equity ~11%; pre-tax cost of debt ~4.5% (HIBOR-linked bank lines and Luxshare loans); ~12% debt weight at market. WACC = 10.0% in every scenario. Cyclicality, customer and controller concentration are priced in the flows and the scenario weights, not stacked onto the discount rate (charge risk once).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment B: the full lease cash payment (FY2025 principal HK$15.8m + interest HK$4.0m = HK$19.8m, 0.16% of revenue) is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities are excluded from total_debt; da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: 207.2 total less 34.7 ROU = 172.5m, 1.39% of revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; NCI stock of HK$7.2m (30 Jun 2026) deducted once in equity_bridge. Negligible after the Time Singapore buyout.
inputs.ebitda_definition: EBITDA margin paths are OPERATING EBITDA: exclude share of results of associates (FY2025 HK$76.3m; H1 FY2026 HK$165.4m, almost all Time Singapore/Leoni) and interest income (both of which the Metrics.csv EBITDA of HK$1,187m includes). FY2025 operating EBITDA = 1,187.2 - 76.3 - 14.6 = 1,096m = 8.8% of revenue; H1 FY2026 ~9.7% on the same basis.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical') with the adaptations file applied: HKD-built WACC, lease treatment B, NCI in bridge, SBC kept explicit (small, not zero), risk charged once. A contract manufacturer whose value is a stream of unlevered FCF is squarely the owner-FCF case; the volatile OCF (FY2023 -1,448m, H1 FY2026 -2,576m) is working-capital build on a revenue base that doubled, not a reason to abandon the model -- it is modelled explicitly through a NEGATIVE wc_capture on the change in revenue, which is the single most consequential driver here. PERIMETER: the flows model the group as consolidated at 30 Jun 2026 (incl. DJC copper wire from Dec 2025) and EXCLUDE Leoni LCS Group / Time Singapore, consolidated only from 1 Aug 2026: its revenue, margins and debt are not in any filing held here (the 25 Jun 2026 circular was not downloaded), so it is carried in equity_bridge at the buyout-implied equity value with its consideration netted off, and its earnings are not in the flows. FY0 is FY2025 (Dec year-end; the company changed year-end from 31 March in 2023, hence the FY2023-9mo stub). Year-1 of the projection is FY2026, whose first half is already reported; the H1 FY2026 working-capital burn is therefore charged once in year-1 flows and is also already reflected in the 30 Jun 2026 net cash, a deliberate conservative overlap worth roughly HK$0.4-0.6/share. Buybacks: none ever; the flat count is a modelling convention the company does not fund -- the count has in fact risen 24% in 18 months through placings and acquisition shares, which is genuine non-SBC issuance already in the 2,232m base. SBC-adjusted FCF history: FY2020 128.2, FY2021 92.2, FY2022 146.4, FY2023 -1,675.5, FY2024 805.5, FY2025 458.5.

base.growth_note: FY2026E ~21.1bn organic ex-Leoni: H1 actual 10,066m plus an H2 at or slightly above H1 (record Q2 orders in data centre and server, DJC full half, Morocco ramp). Then AI data-centre growth decelerating as hyperscaler capex normalises; terminal 2.5%.
base.margin_note: Operating EBITDA ex-associates. H1 FY2026 ~9.7%; FY2025 8.8%. Mix drag from server (2.7% segment margin) and copper wire (2.5%) offset by higher-ASP MPO/shuffle-box fibre assemblies (cable assembly 20.4%); modest fade as AI pricing normalises.
base.capex_note: FY2025 cash capex incl. PPE deposits 147m (1.2%); H1 FY2026 net of disposals 94m. Capacity adds in PRC, Vietnam, Mexico, Turkey and Morocco justify running above D&A.
base.tax_note: FY2025 effective 14.9%, cash 15.2%; HK 16.5%, PRC high-tech 15% concessions and Vietnam incentives expire or dilute as the overseas footprint grows.
base.wc_note: NEGATIVE: growth consumes cash. Net working capital (inventory + receivables - payables - contract liabilities) was 13.2% of FY2025 revenue and ~29% of trailing revenue at 30 Jun 2026 after the H1 server/copper build. -15% of each year's revenue increase assumes intensity normalises toward the FY2025 level as the Q2 order spike ships; this is the largest single value driver.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 14x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: (i) >50% of revenue rides one capex cycle, with the lowest-margin line (server, 43% of H1 revenue) the most exposed; (ii) a single controller, Luxshare, is simultaneously parent, HK$3.1bn lender and supply-chain counterparty, so the related-party dependency is of the kind the method says moves bear weight up; (iii) the group has not yet converted its earnings to cash (cumulative owner FCF since FY2023 is negative) and funded the gap with a 24% dilution. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things -- an extended AI cycle, a mix-driven margin lift, and Leoni integration -- to all go right. Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
